headword: {見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}める
gloss: to expect something in return; to seek a reward

definitions.gloss: to expect something in return; to seek a reward or favor back
definitions.explanation: To do something while expecting a benefit, favor, or compensation in return. {見返|みかえ}り means a return favor or reward.

examples.japanese: {見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めない。
examples.english: to not expect anything in return.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めて{手伝|てつだ}ったようだ。
examples.english: It seems he helped expecting something in return.

examples.japanese: {本当|ほんとう}の{親切|しんせつ}とは、{見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めずに{人|ひと}を{助|たす}けることだ。
examples.english: True kindness means helping people without expecting anything in return.

notes:
{見返|みかえ}り (a return, recompense) + を{求|もと}める (to seek). Describes acting out of self-interest, expecting a favor, payment, or advantage back. It is often used in the negative — {見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めない praises selfless behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めずに: without expecting anything in return
- {見返|みかえ}りとして: in return for

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見返|みかえ}り: a return favor, compensation — the noun on its own
- {報酬|ほうしゅう}を{求|もと}める: to seek payment — specifically a monetary reward
